nodes.name: asset_types.yaml
nodes.summary: Seed YAML taxonomy engagement-asset nạp vào Skillogy skill graph: mỗi entry trở thành một node :AssetType, trường category tạo property và wire edge HAS_SUBTYPE category→child (root 'asset' không có), trường phases (tùy chọn) wire edge ENGAGED_VIA AssetType→:Phase cho từng phase liệt kê - kết nối taxonomy với skill graph live để classifier resolve asset→phase→skills/MoC/agent; mọi giá trị phases BẮT BUỘC là :Phase.name trong phases.yaml. Khoảng 170 loại asset theo nhóm: root + broad categories (service, network-identifier, network-infrastructure, application, software-artifact, hardware-physical, blockchain-asset, communication-integration), network identifiers (cidr/ip/domain/subdomain/url/asn), identity + email, web/API (http, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, OAuth/SSO), database (mysql/mssql/postgres/mongodb/redis/oracle) + data storage, directory/identity (AD, LDAP, Kerberos, SAML/OIDC, FIDO2, PKI), remote access (ssh/rdp/winrm/vpn), file share (smb/nfs/ftp), cloud (aws/azure/gcp resources, m365, CI/CD, serverless), container (kubernetes/docker/registry), mobile + desktop app (ipa/apk, electron, browser extension), binary + firmware (elf/pe/macho), software package (npm/pypi/crates/oci, CI pipeline), ICS/OT (modbus, Siemens S7, bacnet, dnp3, opcua), IoT + BLE/Zigbee/Z-Wave/LoRaWAN, wireless, hardware/email/chat, AI/LLM (llm endpoint, rag vector store, model registry, safety classifier), blockchain/DeFi, và forensic evidence (memory/disk/pcap/log).

nodes.name: moc.yaml
nodes.summary: Seed Map-of-Concepts (MoC) - danh sách ~30 entry tạo nên bản tóm tắt navigation ~300 token mà SkillogyMiddleware inject vào system prompt của agent, lọc theo phase hiện hành; parent_phase bắt buộc là :Phase.name từ phases.yaml. Nhóm theo domain: reconnaissance (passive/active/web/AD recon), initial access (web-exploitation SQLi/SSRF/IDOR/XXE/RCE, deserialization gadgets, crypto-attacks padding oracle/JWT confusion), active-directory (credential theft kerberoast/DCSync/LAPS, cert abuse ADCS ESC, coercion PetitPotam/NTLM relay), cloud (IAM privesc, pivot IMDS/S3/tfstate leak, k8s pod escape + RBAC), ai-security (prompt injection, model extraction, data poisoning, RAG attacks), smart contracts (flash-loan/oracle/reentrancy/governance), ics-ot + iot + mobile + wireless, osint + phishing campaigns, reverse-engineering (binary RE), dfir triage, supply-chain compromise, post-exploit (lateral-movement, persistence), và meta (opplan-design, reporting-output).

nodes.name: phases.yaml
nodes.summary: Seed node :Phase canonical cho skill graph, gồm ba nhóm: 13 tactic theo kill chain (reconnaissance→initial-access→execution→persistence→privilege-escalation→defense-evasion→credential-access→discovery→lateral-movement→collection→command-and-control→exfiltration→impact; kill_chain_order 1-13), 14 domain category không nằm trên kill chain (active-directory, cloud, web-exploitation, mobile, ics-ot, iot, wireless, ai-security, reverse-engineering, dfir, osint, phishing, smart-contracts, supply-chain, post-exploit; order 100+), và 7 engagement-meta phi offensive (reporting, planning, orchestration, adversary-emulation, analyst, opsec, benchmark; order 200+). Danh sách mirror subdomains canonical trong packages/raptix/raptix/skill_audit/subdomains.yaml nhưng được copy thay vì import để builder package giữ zero runtime dependency với validator package, đồng thời cho phép 'phases mà graph traverse' và 'subdomains mà author được khai báo' phân kỳ tường minh trong tương lai; kill_chain_order chỉ dùng cho hiển thị/routing ổn định.
